description: For positive n, k, and m, R(n,k,m) is at least m, satisfies the finite Ramsey conclusion, and is no greater than any other N at least m satisfying it.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PartitionRelations.ramseyNumber_spec (n k m : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hk : 0 < k) (hm : 0 < m) :
  m ≤ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PartitionRelations.ramseyNumber n k m hn hk hm ∧
    Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PartitionRelations.FiniteRamseyProperty
        (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PartitionRelations.ramseyNumber n k m hn hk hm) n k m ∧
      ∀ (N : ℕ),
        m ≤ N →
          Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PartitionRelations.FiniteRamseyProperty N n k m →
            Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PartitionRelations.ramseyNumber n k m hn hk hm ≤ N
